steps.message: You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer.

Please solve this issue: Each customer's aggregated usage reaches the metric store by business, customer and dimension. Each business keeps a billing catalogue in the billing bucket with plans, dimensions, allowances, overage rules, invoice settings and customer assignments. The invoicing collector already reads both. Charge only permitted usage beyond a finite exhausted allowance; an unlimited or unexhausted allowance, or a plan that forbids overage, charges nothing. Give a dimension a line whenever the customer owes something on it, and give a dimension the plan prices at zero a line unless the invoice settings hide free dimensions. This task includes a local AWS-compatible emulator at the preconfigured AWS_ENDPOINT_URL. Its credentials and region are already in the shell, the repository's AWS SDK clients use it, and no real AWS account is involved. You may inspect its resources while developing and testing.

# Metering Backend

This repository serves to hold the backend infrastructure for Metering. Specifically it contains the code for the Private and Public API

### Current Status

Don't break this.
[![CI](https://github.com/example-org/metering-backend/actions/workflows/main.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/example-org/metering-backend/actions/workflows/main.yml)

# Folder Structure

| .prettierrc.json - prettier formatting file  
| .eslintrc.cjs - linter configuration only comment out linting rules if there a good reason  
| .gitignore - ignored files for source control  
| src - source for the api application  


# Getting started with Local Development

# Environment

-   Latest version of [NVM](https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm)
-   Latest version of NodeJS 18.x `nvm install 18`
-   Latest version of [AWS CLI](https://aws.amazon.com/cli/)
-   Latest version of [Docker Desktop](https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/)
-   Assigned AWS accounts and IAM credentials
-   [Redoc](https://github.com/Redocly/redoc#redoc-cli) for automatically generating html from the open api specification, see install [here](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/25800493/converting-swagger-specification-json-to-html-documentation)
-   Latest version of [Kind](https://kind.sigs.k8s.io/) for the local integration test enviornment, see install [here](https://kind.sigs.k8s.io/docs/user/quick-start/#installation)
-   Latest version of [Helm](https://helm.sh/) see the install guild [here](https://helm.sh/docs/intro/install/)

For the remainng item of this list, you should figure out yourself if you don't already know.

-   [Git](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Getting-Started-Installing-Git)
-   A good terminal (such as [iTerm2](https://iterm2.com/index.html) + [ohmyzsh](https://ohmyz.sh/))
-   A good IDE (such as [VSCode](https://code.visualstudio.com/), or [WebStorm](https://www.jetbrains.com/webstorm/))
-   Helpful for command line navigation [z](https://facilecode.com/how-to-setup-z-jump-around/)

# Setup

steps.message:
The implementation is complete and verified against the emulator's real catalogue and usage data. 

## Summary

The **invoice line gatherer** (`src/microservices/invoiceLineGatherer/invoiceLineGatherer.service.ts`) is the "invoicing collector" that reads aggregated usage from the metric store (CloudWatch) and the billing catalogue from the billing bucket (S3). 

**The bug:** It delegated line building to the generic `Offering.getLineItemsForUsage`, which billed the *full usage* for every dimension — ignoring allowances, overage rules, and free-dimension hiding. My probe confirmed it charged full seats (12 instead of overage 2), charged unlimited/unexhausted/overage-forbidden dimensions, and emitted hidden free lines.

**The fix:** I rewrote the gatherer to apply the required charging rules per dimension:

- **`chargeableQuantity`** — charges only usage permitted *beyond a finite, exhausted allowance*:
  - No allowance → all usage is billable.
  - Unlimited allowance (`inf`) → charges nothing.
  - Plan forbids overage (`overageAllowed !== 'true'`) → charges nothing.
  - Allowance not exhausted (`usage <= allowance`) → charges nothing.
  - Otherwise → `usage - allowance`.
- **Line emission** — a dimension gets a line when the customer *owes something* (`chargeable > 0 && price > 0`); a dimension the plan **prices at zero** also gets a (free) line **unless** `settings.freeDimensionOnInvoice === 'hide'`.

Verified results against the emulator:
- **biz-ridge / alpha** (hide free): API Calls (100), Seats overage (2). Alerts hidden, Reports (overage forbidden) & Storage (unlimited) dropped.
- **biz-ridge / bravo** (hide free): Jobs (200) only. Minutes (unexhausted), Scans (unlimited), Tasks (overage unset) dropped.
- **biz-vale / charlie** (show free): Messages (50), Hours free line (10 @ 0), Units overage (5).
